snippet.title: Dino Path Trail - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
After more than three years of development, Dino Path Trail is finally out on Steam. Developed by indie studio Void Pointer and published by Human Qube Games, the game throws players into a brutal frontier where dinosaurs never went extinct and the Wild West never died.

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2481670/Dino_Path_Trail/
